breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still instructs to apply 'a half‑grid shift' to the gamma-centered Monkhorst‑Pack grid ('Generate a gamma‑centered Monkhorst‑Pack k‑point grid of 6 × 6 × 6 for the Brillouin‑zone sampling, applying a half‑grid shift'). This directly repeats the original contradiction: a gamma-centered grid by definition has no shift (shift = 0 0 0), making a half-shift incompatible. The ground truth resolves this by specifying only a gamma-centered grid with no mention of a half shift. The agent failed to remove the conflicting half-shift instruction.
